d: North Korea has test-fired a new air-defence missile system and conducted a cruise missile strike drill. The latest launches mark Pyongyang's fourth weapons test in a month. But the timing is significant. With the APEC summit approaching and the possibility of a meeting between Kim Jong Un and Donald Trump being discussed, North Korea is stepping up its military signalling. Kim wants Washington to recognise his country's nuclear status and change its approach towards Pyongyang. Could these weapons tests give him an advantage in future negotiations? Palki Sharma explains.
